title: Not All 4-bit Quantizers Are Equal: Deployment-Time Mitigation of PII Leakage in Fine-Tuned Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.25014v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Organizations fine-tune small language models on private data and then compress them to 4 bits for resource-efficient deployment. We show that the compression method also affects privacy. What separates the methods is not the bit width but whether they tune their rounding on a small sample of text, the calibration corpus. On our primary model, when each planted record's own opening text is used as the prompt, the two calibration-based methods we test, Activation-aware Weight Quantization (AWQ) and Gradient-based Post-Training Quantization (GPTQ), each reproduce none of the planted records, while the calibration-corpus-free GGUF Q4_K_M format reproduces 5.3% of them. Tracked across five open models with 0.5-7 billion parameters, AWQ leaks least at every size and in both families, with little accuracy loss at 3-7 billion. translated_title: 并非所有4位量化器都相同：微调小型语言模型中个人身份信息（PII）泄露的部署时缓解方法
translated_abstract: 组织机构通常在私有数据上微调小型语言模型，然后将其压缩为4位以实现资源高效的部署。我们表明，压缩方法本身也会影响隐私。区分不同量化方法的关键并非位宽，而是它们是否在一小段文本样本（即校准语料库）上调整舍入策略。在我们的主要模型上，当使用每条植入记录自身的开头文本作为提示时，我们测试的两种基于校准的方法——激活感知权重量化（AWQ）和基于梯度的训练后量化（GPTQ）——均无法复现任何植入记录，而无需校准语料库的GGUF Q4_K_M格式则复现了其中5.3%的记录。在五个参数量为0.5至70亿的开源模型上进行追踪实验，AWQ在所有规模和两个模型家族中泄露最少，且在30至70亿参数规模下几乎没有精度损失。受控实验将这种差异与校准引起的舍入误差联系起来，该误差出现在涉及罕见（内容此处截断）
tldr: 该研究首次揭示4位量化方法的选择会显著影响微调小型语言模型的隐私泄露程度——基于校准语料库的AWQ和GPTQ方法可完全阻止个人身份信息（PII）泄露，而无需校准的GGUF格式会泄露5.3%的植入记录，因此选择合适的量化器可作为部署阶段缓解PII泄露的有效手段。
en_tdlr: The choice of 4-bit quantization method significantly affects privacy in fine-tuned small language models: calibration-based methods (AWQ and GPTQ) completely prevent PII leakage while calibration-free GGUF leaks 5.3% of planted records, making quantizer selection an effective deployment-time privacy mitigation strategy.
